questions.q: You quote a customer today. Which field changes to QUOTED?
questions.e: amountBasis moves from ESTIMATED to QUOTED. At the same time put the quotation number in quoteRef and move the stage to Proposal.

questions.q: A deal has gone to a competitor. What is the minimum you must record?
o: Stage Closed Lost plus a lostReason
questions.e: Closed Lost plus a lostReason is mandatory - here, Lost to Competitor. Also set competitorDisplaced so the displacement picture stays accurate. Never delete the deal.

o: amount divided by the number of stages
the sum of Commit deals only
questions.e: amount times probability, held in weightedValue and summed on the Command Centre's Weighted Pipeline tile.

questions.q: What must be true before a deal sits at Proposal?
o: A formal quotation or proposal has been issued
The close date is inside this quarter
questions.e: Proposal means the quote is in the customer's hands. That is also when the Intact quotation number goes into quoteRef and amountBasis flips to QUOTED.
